title: U-Con 2018 Set B: Colonies, Bonfire, Tragic Hero, Horn of Plenty, Mandarin

sources.author: Adam Horton
sources.note: Michigan U-Con 2018 Tournament Summary; Set 2018-B (semifinal), Horton won

quality_note: Horton names the Mandarin/Horn trick, explains why he skipped it (Militia, Colonies) and won with a Jack/Bonfire thin deck and 6 Colonies.

kingdom.setup_notes: Tournament rule (U-Con): players may arrange their starting decks, so they choose a 4/3 or 5/2 opening. 3-player game. Cemetery's Heirloom: each player starts with Haunted Mirror in place of one Copper. Played with the 2018 Bonfire, which trashed up to 2 cards you have in play (any cards, not only Coppers).

edition: First-edition Mandarin; pre-errata Bonfire (could trash any cards in play).
